notes.title: Our statement regarding Unity policy changes
17/03/2022 1.1.4b26 Bugfix Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35389931/5fce7a95b40fd158e6b59c534a02d324e0c2b385.png[/img]

Attention fellow survivors!

Do you remember the feeling of losing control? Especially while switching from gamepad to keyboard? This will trouble you no more, because we have fixed that! Furthermore we have managed to fix the issue of settings and controls not saving after closing the panel with the Escape key and implemented few additional improvements to enhance user experience on Steam Deck. Don't forget to check it out and share your handheld experience with us. Oh and don't forget to grab few cans of nutritious soup on the way!


☢️ [b][u]17/03/2022 1.1.4b26 Bugfix Update[/u][/b] ☢️

[b]BUGFIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issues with switching from gamepad to keyboard 
[*]Fixed settings and controls not saved when settings panel was closed with Esc key
[*]Updated Unity and plugins
[*]Improvements for user experience on Steam Deck
[/list]

notes.title: 03/11/2021 1.1.3b21 Bugfix Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35389931/5fce7a95b40fd158e6b59c534a02d324e0c2b385.png[/img]

Hello shelter dwellers!

Do you feel stuck in a nuclear bunker, and nothing moves forward? That could be caused by a bug, that was just fixed! Today's update repairs being stuck on day to day transition, improves controller navigation and even lets you grab items while being in drop zone! Now nothing will stop you from scavenging freely, except the 60 seconds time limit before inevitable nuclear apocalypse! Enjoy!


☢️ [b][u]03/11/2021 1.1.3b21 Bugfix Update[/u][/b] ☢️

[b]BUGFIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed one situation where game was being stuck on day to day transition 
[*]Controller navigation fixes and improvements
[*]Fixed grabbing items while being in drop zone in scavenge
[*]Fixed share your adventure feature
[/list]

notes.title: 05/08/2021 1.1.2 Bugfix Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35389931/5fce7a95b40fd158e6b59c534a02d324e0c2b385.png[/img]

Hello there, fellow survivors!


Sitting in the shelter all day long might be tiring and exhausting, but don’t you worry! We have something that might cheer you up. Our next update should help you with your motor skills while you scavenge for supplies and we finally fixed the unmotivating black screen that stopped you from playing the game. Now there should be nothing stopping you from jumping into action. Just like jumping into the shelter. And remember to bring soup!!!

☢️ [b][u]05/08/2021 1.1.2 Bugfix Update[/u][/b] ☢️

[b]BUGFIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Gamepad navigation improvements during the scavenge part
[*]Scavenge camera improvements
[*]Controls mapping fixes
[*]Game not starting bug fix - Broken saves causing that issue will be now automatically deleted.
[/list]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35389931/5fce7a95b40fd158e6b59c534a02d324e0c2b385.png[/img]

Hello atomic survivors!

We heard some rumours that the most comfortable way to play 60 Seconds! Reatomized is when you are sitting in your fallout shelter and eating delicious tomato soup straight from the can! Well, we are not able to provide canned soup for everyone, but luckily, we able to provide full controller support for you to enjoy!

[/list]

[list]

[*] Supplies on rationing page not refreshing after water and/or food was picked in an item event fix

May the soup be with you!🍅

PS. 60 Seconds! Reatomized is now available on three new platforms - Nintendo Switch, Xbox One and PlayStation 4, the atomic adventure is everywheeeeereeeee now🚨

notes.title: 23/12/2019 Shelter Alone - new Challenge patch!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35389931/a31813cc09ef53ae690e60821186a3fbd6050cb9.png[/img]

Survivors, your help is needed!

Timmy's been left alone in the shelter! The family's gone out, he's all on his own and on top of that, there are some shady looking men lurking around. Thankfully, the boy scout knows a thing or two about survival and has a few aces up his sleeve.

Help him drive off the intruders in this new, FREE Survival Challenge for 60 Seconds! Reatomized available NOW!

☢️ [u][b]23/12/2019 New Challenge Patch[/b][/u] ☢️

[b]CONTENT[/b][list]
[*] Shelter Alone - new Survival Challenge Added
[/list]

Don't let those pesky intruders ruin this year's shelter Christmas!

The shelter radio's picking up some strange broadcast:
"Attention Survivors! [b]60 Parsecs! has gone mobile![/b] The sequel to 60 Seconds! is now available on three new platforms - [b]Nintendo Switch, Android & iOS[/b]. Get to the shuttle and take survival to the next level - space level."

notes.title: 26/11/2019 Turkish translation & bugfix patch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35389931/5fce7a95b40fd158e6b59c534a02d324e0c2b385.png[/img]

Howdy, Survivors!

Today’s update is a special one, as it comes with a little extra something. Something a lot of you have been asking about. We’re happy to announce that the Turkish language option has been added to the game! Along with it come some additional tweaks, aimed at improving your quality of survival. Take a look:

☢️ [u][b]26/11/2019 1.0.391 Bugfix Patch[/b][/u] ☢️
[list]
[*] added Turkish language option
[*] fixed small issues with other translations
[*] fixed item/character icons in the Journal not being loaded correctly after loading the game
[*] fixed issue with some events not being scheduled correctly if character is on expedition
[/list]

No point in waiting! Update the game and dive straight into the shelter! Just remember to watch your head.

Soup eaters!

It’s another one of those days when we add some spices to our Reatomized soup and adjust the flavor a little bit. We hope that with this pinch of spicy tweaks and bugfixes, it’ll be even more delicious! So, without further ado, here’s today’s menu:

[b]BUGFIXES[/b]

[*]adjusted Merrymen event to not count damaged items into “Rich” threshold

We’re making this soup with love and we hope you keep enjoying it as much as we do making it better!

Enjoy your soup!

notes.title: Post-release update and performance Patch 1.0.369
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35389931/5fb127a31527694ba6e7506c7457ec24104516b7.png[/img]

Survivors!

We are extremely grateful for your feedback on 60 Seconds! Reatomized and for reporting all issues that occurred in your game. We are investigating all described problems to make sure you can all play our game without any fallout (fallout, ha-ha) 🍅

We have just released the second patch, please find what’s changed, below:

☢️ [b][u] 26/07/2019 1.0.369 Performance Patch [/u][/b] ☢️

[b]OPTIMIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*] Scavenge texture optimization pass
[*] Optimized memory allocation in menu and survival
[/list]

[b]BALANCE[/b]
[list]
[*] Scavenge character acceleration increased
[/list]

Please don’t hesitate to share your feedback with us. If you encounter any problems with 60 Seconds! Reatomized, please contact us at support@robotgentleman.com and describe the problem you’re experiencing. Please try to provide as much information as possible. We are truly thankful for all the comments, emails and posts from you! 


Keep being awesome, survivors!
